Messages.Author: Cartman
Messages.Body:
I play a Force of Will with Muaziz and one of my prey's minion blocks her. I
tap Ublo to enter combat instead of Muaziz. At the end of the combat, who
goes to torpor because of the FoW?

Thanx

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On Tue, 04 Feb 2003 18:07:26 GMT, "Cartman" <federi...@libero.it>
wrote:

>I play a Force of Will with Muaziz and one of my prey's minion blocks her. I
>tap Ublo to enter combat instead of Muaziz. At the end of the combat, who
>goes to torpor because of the FoW?

Muaziz.

Muaziz is the only one taking the action, effects of the action can
only be applied to her.

Carpe noctem.

Lasombra

http://www.TheLasombra.com
